page.layout: One printed page with one column of running text. Marginal notes in the left margin, fragmentary and cut off by the scan edge. Running head at top centre, page number at top left. Catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: ctos & curribus impositos in urbem misit, quorum princeps erat Phocion vir optimus, sed nimiæ plebis potentiæ semper adversatus, quique sub Antipatro clavum reipublicæ tenuerat. Eos omnes ad tribunal raptos populus capitis damnavit, occiditque. Cassander digresso Polyperchonte, obsidione solutâ, munitis in Attica locis occupatis, Æginām partibus suis adjunxit, Salaminem obsedit, Athenienses frustrà conatos præsidia cervicibus suis depellere eò necessitatis adegit, ut pacifci cum ipso ad obtinendam pacem cogerentur. Pax ita convênit, ut urbem, agrum, vectigalia, cæteraqueomnia populus teneret, ac socius Cassandri esset, eique Munychiam relinqueret: plebei, qui infra x minarum censum haberent, à gerendâ republicâ abstinerent: summus reipublicæ & civitatis curator is esset, quem ex civium numero Cassander esset designaturus. Is designavit Demetrium Phalereum Phanostrati filium, virum litteris insigniter politum & celebrem, populari libertati minus æquum, & Macedonicarum partium plus satis, ut judicabant plerique, studiosum; licet alii aliter de eo sentirent, & laudem prudentiæ ac moderationis ei tribuerent, non ad subruendam po-[illegible, ~3 letters]puli
[illegible, fragmentary marginal notes in the left margin; the lines are cut off by the scan edge]

page.notes: The left margin carries several fragmentary notes cut off by the scan edge; they are not legible enough to transcribe and are left as illegible. The word "puli" at the lower right is the catchword, and the text ends with "po-" at the line end, so the catchword duplicates the start of the next page. Long s has been normalised to s. The paragraph is run on without indentation, so it is treated as one paragraph continuing from the previous page. Doubtful: "Salamînem" (circumflex over i, read as printed).
